347: ## Dependencies and Parallelization
348: 
349: **Parallel Work Opportunities:**
350: - Phases 2-3 can partially overlap (error transformation independent of interceptors)
351: - Phase 5 (deduplication) can be developed in parallel with Phase 4 (retry)
352: - Phase 7 (factory) can be developed in parallel with Phase 6 (cache)

355: **Critical Dependencies:**
356: - Phase 1 must complete before all others (foundation)
357: - Phase 2 must complete before Phase 4 (retry needs error transformation)
358: - Phases 3-7 must complete before Phase 8 (integration tests need all features)
359: - Phase 8 must complete before Phase 11 (final validation)
